ipa.dates_and_calendars.add_periods.Definitions

Add periods definitions object

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.dates_and_calendars.add_periods.Definitions.

Syntax

Definitions(universe: DefnDefns)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
universe DefnDefns Yes List of initialized Definition objects to retrieve data.

Methods

get_data

Sends a request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

get_data(session: Session | None = None) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

get_data_async

Sends an asynchronous request to the Data Platform to retrieve the predefined data.

async get_data_async(
    session: Session | None = None,
    on_response: Callable | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
) -> T

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.
on_response Callable | None No None Callable function to process the retrieved data.
closure str | None No None Closure parameters that will be returned with the response.

Returns

Response

Returns as the result of successful response from Data Platform.

Example

import datetime
from lseg.data.content.ipa.dates_and_calendars import add_periods

first_definition = add_periods.Definition(
    tag="first",
    start_date="2020-01-01",
    period="4D",
    calendars=["BAR", "KOR", "JAP"],
    currencies=["USD"],
    date_moving_convention=add_periods.DateMovingConvention.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY,
    end_of_month_convention=add_periods.EndOfMonthConvention.LAST,
    holiday_outputs=["Date", "Calendars", "Names"]
)
second_definition = add_periods.Definition(
    tag="second",
    start_date="2018-01-01",
    period="4D",
    calendars=["BAR", "JAP"],
    currencies=["USD"],
    date_moving_convention=add_periods.DateMovingConvention.NEXT_BUSINESS_DAY,
    end_of_month_convention=add_periods.EndOfMonthConvention.LAST28,
    holiday_outputs=[add_periods.HolidayOutputs.DATE, add_periods.HolidayOutputs.NAMES]
)
response = add_periods.Definitions([first_definition, second_definition]).get_data()

# Using get_data_async

import asyncio
task = add_periods.Definitions([first_definition, second_definition]).get_data_async()
response = asyncio.run(task)
